title: SteamWar Basics
description: Mods useful to play on the Server SteamWar. All mods in this list are allowed and, for example, help you build more efficiently
body:
# Useful mods for a better experience playing on SteamWar.de

**all mods were approved by server staff to be allowed**

This pack includes **performance mods** and **Iris for shaders**

**Axiom** for quicker designing of fighting machines and easier building of cannons, shields etc.

**WorldEdit** for when you need WorldEdit in singleplayer

**Chat Notify** to get an audible indication you were mentioned in chat. Useful when tabbed out to not miss important messages

**Copy That** to copy chat messages

**Gamma Utensils** and **Zoomify** for fullbright and zoom. The two most commonly used features to play on SteamWar

**Stendhal** allows you to create better signage and books for settings or infrastructure

**No Chat Report** to disable the popup about chat reports. Chat reports are disabled server-side

**Chat Heads** just for looks

<details>
<summary>Q&A</summary>

## What is SteamWar and how do I Join

- SteamWar.de is a Redstone TNT Fighting machine focused server. The IP is [**SteamWar.de**](https://steamwar.de)
- It is recommended to play on the newest version listed on their website

## I cannot see the Axiom UI

You are likely either:

- Not on a build server (`/b`)
- On a build server running on a different version than you
</details>
